title: Browser approval gates
summary: A recipe step typed operator_gate machine_browser_approval approves the installer's Match code in the test machine's own signed-in browser: Safari on macOS, the desktop Chromium on Linux and WSL. Every driver shares one matcher: only the installer-opened tab on the declared origin with the displayed code, revalidated before Approve machine is pressed, and only a same-origin navigation away from it counts. On Linux the gate runs xdg-settings get default-web-browser inside a login shell, the same read the Machine QA provisioner uses, and starts Chromium with that shell's XDG_DATA_DIRS; a bare SSH environment is not consulted. When that desktop file is absent, the existing Chromium snap entry is the default, and /snap/bin/chromium counts even though it resolves to the snap binary. It then starts the desktop and Chromium with a loopback DevTools port and runs the installer on that desktop; the step always attaches a desktop screenshot. A host without a desktop refuses headless_linux_browser_approval_unavailable. A login shell that cannot print XDG_DATA_DIRS refuses linux_desktop_session_environment_unavailable. Both name the provisioning recovery. A setup that exits before or during approval fails the gate as terminal_setup_exited with its exit code and printed refusal, not as missing approval context. When the helper does not confirm the approval, the gate fails at once as machine_browser_approval_not_confirmed instead of waiting out gate_timeout_seconds; the helper's own code stays in browser_automation_error_code with a recovery. While it waits, each heartbeat prints a machine_qa.heartbeat line (phase operator_gate) that yoke watch qa-plan counts as progress; starting-state reset, fixture cleanup and restore print the same line on a background heartbeat. Safari confirms an in-place approval by the Machine connected heading, matched by value, name or title over one window walk per poll; a confirmation that never appears records observed_url, confirmation_wait_seconds and last_error. Approval coordinates use the shared MATCH_CODE_ALPHABET, MATCH_CODE_LENGTH and derived MATCH_CODE_PATTERN exported by yoke_contracts.machine_authorization: exactly four characters from 23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ. The complete verification URI must contain exactly the displayed match code on the declared HTTPS origin. Other code formats, mismatched codes, duplicate query values and unrelated origins refuse before browser approval.
